gloss: neglect of health; unhealthy lifestyle; intemperance

definitions.gloss: neglect of health; unhealthy lifestyle; intemperance
definitions.explanation: A lifestyle that disregards health, including poor diet, lack of sleep, excessive drinking, or other habits harmful to the body.

examples.japanese: {不摂生|ふせっせい}がたたって{倒|たお}れた。
examples.english: He collapsed because of his unhealthy lifestyle.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}の{不摂生|ふせっせい}が{今|いま}になって{体|からだ}に{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: The unhealthy habits from my youth are catching up with my body now.

examples.japanese: {医者|いしゃ}に{不摂生|ふせっせい}な{生活|せいかつ}を{改|あらた}めるように{言|い}われた。
examples.english: The doctor told me to change my unhealthy lifestyle.

notes:
USAGE:
{不摂生|ふせっせい} refers broadly to a lifestyle that neglects health — poor eating habits, excessive drinking, lack of exercise, sleep deprivation, and similar. It is often used when explaining the cause of health problems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不摂生|ふせっせい}がたたる (for unhealthy habits to catch up with someone)
- {不摂生|ふせっせい}な{生活|せいかつ} (an unhealthy lifestyle)
- {不摂生|ふせっせい}を{改|あらた}める (to change one's unhealthy habits)

GRAMMAR:
Can function as a noun or as a na-adjective ({不摂生|ふせっせい}な).
